# Synthetic request coverage — fixtures only

The fixtures declare a synthetic FULL_SLICE route, not the installed Windows/Bambu route. No real file/process observation occurs. The finite A policy identities are SHA256 of UTF-8 `synthetic A policy <name>` for extraction/argv/semantic_env/request_resource/paths/backend; versions synthetic-A/0.2. These are explicit fixture assumptions reviewed by contract tests, not production certification or Author acceptance.

## Request resources

The fixture route explicitly requests cli-limits.json as toolpath request configuration through the typed resource argv token. Its exact synthetic bytes are `synthetic requested CLI limits` (30 bytes); SHA is pinned in both triples. The fixture's request_resource policy selects this singleton set; selection role is selected_toolpath_request_configuration and evidence_pointer references this section. It is selected because of this declared request role, not because a candidate exists. No bundled runtime/library entry is requested.

Backend fixture source bytes are `synthetic source <name>` for custom.py/job.py/progress.py/runner.py; first is an explicitly declared custom execution dependency, other three backend_core. No Python runtime/stdlib closure is asserted. Engine bytes are `synthetic v02 executable`, version synthetic-02.08.02.61. Geometry SHA fixtures derive from `synthetic geometry permanent` and `synthetic geometry authored_support`; printer/process/filament bytes from `printer`, `process`, `PETG`, `PLA`. These bytes are synthetic declarations, not files discovered by generator.

The synthetic paths policy declares the output slot purely destination-only and pins output_only_destination. Its physical path has no request semantics for this fixture route; output_paths metadata is non-key. cwd and final argv path have no neutrality proof and remain opaque exact A bindings. The explicit SYNTHETIC_REQUEST_MODE override is semantic A; no inherited environment is asserted known or compatible.

All seven request_attestations assert only this finite fixture A set. B/C pointers identify uncollected documents; changing them changes no A bytes and establishes no compatibility. Missing/false A attestation produces HOLD. Production route selection/coverage, fresh byte evidence and actual descriptor conversion require the next separate Author-gated task.
